titleStmt.author: Jane Calvert
Pablo Schyfter

span.label: the collaborations between STS researchers and artists/designers who engaged synthetic biology on the Synthetic Aesthetics project, focused on three paired residencies
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: what science and technology studies can learn from art and design
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the argument that engaging closely with art and design can enrich STS by helping it develop an emergent, co-produced form of critique, rather than by treating art/design instrumentally
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critique
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the similarities (shared objectives of 'opening up' and 'critique') and differences (making tangible artefacts, play and humour) between STS work and art/design work in engagements with synthetic biology
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ethnographic observation and semi-structured interviews across six four-week reciprocal residencies, together with analysis of the pairs' jointly authored book chapters
span.term: ethnographic observation and semi-structured interviews across six four-week reciprocal residencies, together with analysis of the pairs' jointly authored book chapters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The exchanges were made reciprocal - artists/designers spent time in the science lab and scientists/engineers spent an equal time in the art studio - so obligation ran both ways and the creative process was shared.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 'Opening up' works by drawing attention to the implicit assumptions underlying a technology, letting new questions be asked and marginalised perspectives and alternative pathways be surfaced.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Critical designers produce speculative objects that make abstract ideas tangible and open to discussion, using design to provoke reflection rather than to sell.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: By using the same tools and materials as the laboratory and getting one's hands 'wet', the maker becomes implicated in manipulating life and cannot take a distanced stance.
span.term: getting hands wet implicates the maker
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: An emergent critique is generated because it is co-produced by people from different disciplines, so what results is more than and different from what any single discipline could produce.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because the artefacts have a materiality and an immediacy, they can travel and be discussed more widely than academic papers, driving conversations well beyond the objects themselves.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: There is a danger of putting art and design into an instrumental role that merely performs a service for STS, which the authors are wary of.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Warmer uptake of art/design by the field raises the risk that their critical interventions are co-opted, assimilated and neutralised.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 'STS' is notoriously heterogeneous, so any account of what STS can learn rests on a contestable characterisation of the field.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper explicitly declines to set up a hierarchy with art/design above STS or to claim art/design has nothing to learn from STS.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Experimental collaborations of the kind advocated are necessarily risky, because their outcomes are not obvious from the outset.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Non-verbal artistic work carries a heightened danger of being misunderstood, misframed or misused against the artist's intentions.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The three art/design pairs and the STS researchers shared two objectives - 'opening up' synthetic biology and 'critique'.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Engaging more closely with art and design can enrich STS work by enabling an emergent form of critique.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The most important difference is that artists and designers make tangible artefacts, which the STS researchers' academic texts lack.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A speculative object can be embraced by the very field it critiques - the Scatalog was taken up by the Beijing Genomics Institute to represent a desired research end-point.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Many synthetic biologists appear happier to collaborate with designers than with social scientists, and those collaborations show less divergence in expectations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Michael separates speculative design (open-ended) from critical design on the grounds that critical design has a pre-defined target of critique.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How art/design work is labelled matters less than whether it provokes ongoing exploration and discussion.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
